### (a) Three social posts

1. We believe that if superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, it will double the pace of scientific discovery. That means faster answers to hard questions—and a new era of scientific progress.

2. We see a future where discovery moves twice as fast. If superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, it will double the pace of scientific discovery, accelerating the search for new medicines, materials and energy solutions.

3. We stand for a bold scientific future: if superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, it will double the pace of scientific discovery. We must prepare to turn that acceleration into progress that benefits everyone.

### (b) Newsletter opening

We believe that if superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, it will double the pace of scientific discovery. This is the future we are working toward: one in which researchers answer fundamental questions faster, explore more ideas and open new paths in medicine, energy and materials science. We see scientific progress as a public good, and we want its acceleration to serve people everywhere. That requires preparation, investment and a clear commitment to sharing the benefits. We are ready to champion that work. Doubling the pace of discovery means expanding what humanity can understand and achieve—and we intend to help make that promise real.
